salary_details.details: Selected candidates for both the Homoeopathy Specialist Doctor and Ayurveda Specialist Doctor posts will be paid a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 52,550/- plus Rs. 5,000/- PG Allowance (PG allowance is applicable only to postgraduate degree holders). The monthly amount is released subject to satisfactory performance of duties.

selection_process: Selection to the above posts will be made based on:
Merit (marks obtained in the qualifying degree) - 70% weightage Experience - 20% weightage Interview conducted by the District Ayush Committee - 10% weightage
The merit list for the Specialist Doctor posts will be prepared based on the marks secured in the qualifying degree.
how_to_apply: Visit the official Kolar district website: zpkolar.karnataka.gov.in
Download the application form for the Ayurveda/Homoeopathy Specialist Doctor post.
Fill in the application form in your own handwriting with accurate details.
Attach self-attested copies of the required documents and two passport-size photographs.
Place the filled application and documents in a sealed envelope.
Submit the sealed application in person, or send it by registered post, to the address below within the due date.
District Ayush Officer, District Ayush Office, S.N.R. Hospital Premises, Kolar - 563101.
important_instructions: The contract appointment is purely temporary and will end on 31 March 2027, subject to further extension decisions by the Ayush Directorate and District Ayush Committee. Selected candidates must stay at the headquarters station and be available for emergency duty round the clock. The contract appointment can be terminated at any time without assigning a reason, or by either party giving one month's notice. Candidates will not have any right to permanent appointment, pension, retirement gratuity, pay scale, or other allowances. The contract appointment is specific to the hospital mentioned; there is no provision for transfer or deputation to another hospital, clinic, or district. Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will be rejected without notice. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Zilla Panchayat Kolar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Homoeopathy and Ayurveda Specialist Doctor posts is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Zilla Panchayat Kolar Ayush Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies in total - 1 post of Homoeopathy Specialist Doctor and 1 post of Ayurveda Specialist Doctor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for Zilla Panchayat Kolar Specialist Doctor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MS/MD postgraduate degree relevant to the post (Homoeopathy or Ayurveda specialisation). BHMS candidates with 3 years of experience may also be considered for the Homoeopathy post, without PG allowance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Zilla Panchayat Kolar Ayush Doctor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will get a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 52,550/- plus Rs. 5,000/- PG allowance.

faq.question: Q5. Is Zilla Panchayat Kolar Recruitment 2026 a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. This is a purely temporary, contract-based appointment under the National Ayush Mission, valid up to 31 March 2027, subject to further extension.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Zilla Panchayat Kolar Ayush Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be downloaded from the official Kolar district website, filled in, and submitted offline (in person or by registered post) to the District Ayush Office, Kolar, in a sealed envelope before the last date.
